test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

Option 1) BT – GK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d63fba63443624e0994a267dc10bc6ae0fc9c2e0b613c9ceac94fb0cadbc575.png] 

Option 2) DV – IN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f84cf46078cea1d3a0b1de6f83f3a295f1a8df4e9176af04ad7d4eeac2a6f2f.png] 

Option 3) IA – NR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d122295d7c4414f965251d08bec74c9bd89b9e1d250860cc44880f1f8205b245.png] 

Option 4) KC – PT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b56505fab3a7aa6108bfb344a810251780764f5bb5a00cfc6d16028d683c620.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'DV – IN' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
